row.name: cash_bank_accounts_employee_primary_uq
row.where: is_primary AND employee_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

row.name: journal_entries_idempotency_uq
row.where: idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'void'

row.name: cash_bank_accounts_employee_check
row.value: employee_id IS NULL OR (account_type IN ('bank', 'ewallet') AND opening_balance = 0 AND current_balance = 0 AND invoice_usage IS NULL)

row.name: cash_bank_accounts_invoice_usage_check
row.value: invoice_usage IS NULL OR invoice_usage IN ('vat', 'non_vat')

row.name: chart_of_accounts_cash_flow_category_check
row.value: cash_flow_category IS NULL OR cash_flow_category IN ('operating', 'investing', 'financing')

row.name: finance_code_numberings_reset_check
row.value: reset_policy IS NULL OR reset_policy IN ('never', 'yearly', 'monthly')

row.name: payment_terms_discount_check
row.value: discount_percent IS NULL OR (discount_percent >= 0 AND discount_percent <= 100)
